title.narrative: Fair Focus on Trade - Uitvoeringskosten RVO

description.narrative:
The Fair Focus on Trade (FFT) subsidy instrument is part of the Focus policy framework on cooperation with civil society within the policy on International Development Cooperation 2026 - 2030 of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (see also the letter to parliament of june 27th 2025, documents II, 2024-2025, 36180, nr. 168, “Doing What the Netherlands Does Best – Strategy for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation.”
The objective of FFT is to promote clean and fair trade by strengthening (local) civil society organisations. The instrument focuses on value chains that are of strategic importance to the Netherlands, leveraging Dutch knowledge and expertise to strengthen linkages with Dutch companies at the downstream end of those value chains. This is in line with the Dutch Diamond Approach, which refers to a collaboration between the government, private sector, knowledge institutions and civil society organisations to achieve shared economic and development objectives.
The minister has entrusted the implementation of the subsidy programme to the Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO), an agency of the Ministry of Economic Affairs. The Sustainable Economic Development Department (Trade for Development Team) will remain closely involved throughout the programme’s duration, for example in conducting strategic policy dialogues and ensuring alignment with policy priorities.
